about: Sound packs (docs/agents/sound.md): node tools/sounds.mjs <sources folder> builds assets/audio/<pack>.mp3 and assets/audio/packs.json from this. A pack loads for any of its `for` tags: 'unlock' (once sound is on), 'act N', 'jelly <type>'. A role's `cue` is the sfx call that plays it, recorded or synthesized; `vol` is its loudness; `mode` replace plays it instead of the synthesized sound, layer on top of it; `cap` cuts each take to that many seconds.
